skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply numerical methods for solving equations, approximating functions, and numerical integration.
Use Matlab to implement numerical methods and solve mathematical problems.
Develop problem-solving skills through independent and group work.
Enhance critical thinking by analyzing and solving complex mathematical problems.
Work effectively in teams to solve mathematical problems and complete assignments.
Improve communication skills through presentations and group discussions.
Develop the ability to independently seek and understand new knowledge and technologies.
